text:
[LFAC.1.7.1] A `logical` fact's **identity** is the declared
subset of its slots marked `key`; the remaining slots, marked
`mutable`, are payload. The author declares the role of every
slot with the per-slot `key` / `mutable` markers (the
`field_decl` production is [LGRA.5.1]; the marker tokens are
reserved words per [LLEX.9.5]). Identity
comparison is **exact**: a `tolerance` is admissible only on a
`mutable` slot, never a `key` slot ([LGRA.5.9.10]). Two `Float` keys are
exactly equal when they compare equal under IEEE 754 `==`, so `-0.0` and
`0.0` are one identity ([LDET.3.2.7]). A NaN never reaches a key, because a
NaN `Float` is refused before it enters working memory ([LEXP.4.2]).

idris.name: Lfac_1_7_1__fact
idris.note: A live fact: id, kind, one key natural, one payload natural. Identity is exact equality on the key, as the clause requires; the key's width is collapsed to one value and `tolerance` on mutable slots is not modelled.
